integrity: The finite census is backed by an analytic if-and-only-if classification and an exact exhaustive verifier with two independent implementations of immediate acceptance. The verifier checks every truthful profile and false report, the structural normal form, all counts, and the school-relabeling quotient.
scientific_limitations: Complete only for three students, three unit-capacity schools, complete strict preferences, and a single common strict priority order. The two-student square market is used only for sharpness; school-specific priorities, capacities above one, truncation, outside options, and incomplete information are outside scope.
title: Complete manipulability boundary for common-priority Boston assignment
